test_map_categorical: test the Categorical.map method with a lambda function that transforms values while preserving categories
test_map_str_categories: test the Categorical.map method with str function to transform string and interval category data
test_map_with_dict_series: test the Categorical.map method using a dict or Series mapper to map category values to new values
test_map_with_nan_none: test the Categorical.map method with na_action=None to apply the mapper function to NaN values
test_map_with_nan_ignore: test the Categorical.map method with na_action=ignore to skip NaN values during mapping
